description: This file contains utility functions and types for managing Kubernetes CronJobs, including scheduling calculations, job creation, and active list management.

classes.name: byJobStartTime
classes.description: A type for sorting a list of Kubernetes Jobs by their start time, with a tie-breaker on job name.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of missedSchedulesType enum values.

methods.name: inActiveList
methods.description: Checks if a CronJob's active list contains a job with the specified UID.

methods.name: inActiveListByName
methods.description: Checks if a CronJob's active list contains a job with the specified name and namespace.

methods.name: deleteFromActiveList
methods.description: Removes a job with the specified UID from a CronJob's active list.

methods.name: mostRecentScheduleTime
methods.description: Calculates the most recent schedule time, last schedule, and missed schedule count for a CronJob.

methods.name: nextScheduleTimeDuration
methods.description: Determines the duration until the next schedule, considering missed schedules and current time.

methods.name: nextScheduleTime
methods.description: Finds the next schedule time after the last scheduled time, with warning if too many missed times.

methods.name: getJobFromTemplate2
methods.description: Creates a Job object from a CronJob and scheduled time, setting labels, annotations, and owner references.

methods.name: getTimeHashInMinutes
methods.description: Returns Unix epoch time in minutes for a given scheduled time.
